answer.answer:
The "Ishan Uday" Special Scholarship Scheme For North Eastern Region is a central sector scholarship scheme implemented by the University Grants Commission (UGC) under the Ministry of Education [E01]. The scheme aims to promote higher education in the North Eastern Region by providing equal opportunities for higher studies, increasing the Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER), focusing on professional education, and optimizing budgetary allocation [E01].

The scheme offers 10,000 fresh scholarships annually for general degree courses and technical/professional courses including medical and paramedical courses [E01]. Scholarship amounts are ₹5,400 per month for general degree courses and ₹7,800 per month for technical/medical/professional/paramedical courses [E01]. Payments are made through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to beneficiaries' bank accounts [E01].

Eligibility requirements include being a domicile of the North Eastern Region, having parental annual income not exceeding ₹4,50,000, passing Class 12th in the preceding year, and securing admission in the first year of a degree course at eligible institutions [E02]. The scheme excludes students pursuing open university courses, those already receiving scholarships, those admitted through management quota, and those in diploma courses [E01].

Scholarships are renewed annually during the first degree course subject to good conduct and prescribed attendance [E02]. The application process is conducted online at https://scholarships.gov.in/ and is completely free of cost [E03]. The North Eastern States covered include Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim, and Tripura [E03].
